title: Triage Rail
description: A session rail with an opinion: what needs you, what is recent, what can go. A violet Needs-you strip (oldest wait first), then Now / Today / Yesterday / This week / Earlier, unread rows emphasised, and one Sweep on Earlier that archives idle sessions untouched for 7+ days. No options, no filter menu. Built ONLY from @fraym/ui primitives (ActivityDot, Button, IconButton, Icon, Input, Tooltip, useObservable) plus the rail slot's specVersion 2 channels - one facts observable, one action set, one capability surface - and its own folds over facts.sessions. Imports nothing from the shipped rail: this is the proof that the assembly stack lets a third party build a whole rail from parts.
